items.title: Show HN: AI Purgatory – how long until AI-exposed workers are back on track
items.summary: I worked up this model as a personal project to help figure out how long AI exposed workers are worse off. As a software engineer, I imagine getting laid off and being incapable of finding new work. It Also showcases the impacts of proposed redistribution mechanisms. This model is meant as a device to consider the impact of AI on workers. this is all highly speculative so you can play with the knobs yourself. items.title: Ask HN: "No AI" apps/companies/resources?
items.summary: I know some people might think this is not the best community to ask for this, but I hope I can be pleasantly surprised. Is there any useful/helpful list of apps, companies, or resources in general that avoid AI (they don't have to be vocally or openly "anti", but at least explicitly avoid it) that you know of? I'm not looking to start a discussion on what's good/bad or (un)worthy about AI, or who's for/against, just links and/or communities promoting this sentiment/position. For example, https://www.rebeltechalliance.org would be one of those resources. Thank you (I hope this won't be downvoted to oblivion)! Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50452986 Points: 5 # Comments: 5
